content_metadata.description: An educational video guiding viewers through drawing the alpha glucose structure with step-by-step instructions and visual memory aids.

qAndA.answer: A hexagon, or as the narrator describes it - a candy shape.

Text appears on the screen reading 'Learning is easy with kudizi', with the text 'learn@kudizi.com' appearing afterwards.

props.name: Text ('kudizi', 'IB Biology Revision', 'Topic 2', 'Biological Molecules', 'Glucose', 'in a nutshell')

scenes.title: Introduction

videoEditingDetails.description: Appearing text effect for the title and website address, light green animated lines used as a highlighting effect behind the word 'kudizi'.

activities.description: Narrator introduces the task and writes 'Draw (alpha) glucose (C6H12O6)' on the screen and then proceeds to write the chemical formula for glucose below it.
Narrator guides the viewer step-by-step on how to draw the alpha glucose molecule, starting with a hexagon shape, adding 'O' for oxygen and 'C' for carbon and then the hydroxyls, represented by 'OH'.
Transition to hint with text animation on black background.

Narrator gives visual memory hints to remember how to draw the molecule - candy shape for glucose, cupcake shape for ribose, and ducks on ponds for hydroxyls. This is accompanied by drawings on screen of all mentioned things.
Outro sequence with text and basic animations on screen.

youtube_description:
During 20+years of teaching we know what students struggle with and their common mistakes. We take the complex and simplify it to make it easy to learn and apply. 
Did we nail it for you? Put a comment below…and let us know what else we can explain for you. Biological molecules scare a-lot of students. We put together this series to get students more comfortable with the molecules to draw and recognise. 
#glucose, #alpha glucose, #IB Biology in a nutshell
